[Style] These two overrides are dead code. `SqlClientAttributesGetter` inherits `ServerAttributesGetter` through `DbClientAttributesGetter`, and `ServerAttributesGetter` already defaults both `getServerAddress` and `getServerPort` to `null`; `DbClientAttributesGetter` doesn't redeclare them. Dropping them changes nothing for `ServerAttributesExtractor` or for the `server.address:server.port` target fallback in `DbClientSpanNameExtractor#computeSpanNameStable`. `getDbOperationBatchSize()` returns `1` when `parameterSets.size() == 1`. However, the test expectations in `AbstractAws2RdsDataTest.batchExecuteStatementModelsParameterSetCount()` explicitly omit `db.operation.batch.size` for the single-parameter-set case. This will cause stable-semconv assertions to fail if `SqlClientAttributesExtractor` emits the batch size for `1`. Consider returning `null` for `size == 1` (while still returning `0` and `>= 2`) to align the emitted attribute with the intended 'batch vs non-batch' behavior.

replies.body: The shared `SqlClientAttributesExtractor` already handles this case: it treats a non-null batch size other than `1` as a batch and only emits `db.operation.batch.size` in that branch. Returning `1` here is intentional input to those shared semantics, so no change is needed.

threads.body: The testing module pins `rdsdata` to a fixed version (`2.5.54`) while other AWS SDK compileOnly dependencies are pegged at `2.2.0` and the new test suites use `baseVersion(\"2.5.54\").orLatest()`. To reduce future drift and keep version intent centralized, consider expressing this dependency via the same `baseVersion(...).orLatest()` mechanism (or an existing version catalog/pin used elsewhere in the repo) instead of hardcoding.

replies.body: This `compileOnly` dependency intentionally records the earliest RDS Data SDK version needed to compile the shared test source, like the fixed `bedrockruntime:2.25.63` dependency above it. The consuming test suites use `baseVersion(...).orLatest()` to select the runtime version under test, so no change is needed here.
